title: Listening Drill — Course headphones
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Course headphones
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a pair of course headphones. The main problem is poor sound. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the order number. Then bring the item to the technical desk. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a replacement cable. keep the original cable. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
